name: jira-issues
description: List Jira issues from a JQL query, one line each: key | status | assignee | summary. Prints the next page token when more pages exist.
js: const d = r.issues?.nodes ?? r.data?.issues ?? r.issues ?? []; const t = r.nextPageToken ?? r.data?.nextPageToken ?? r.issues?.nextPageToken; return d.map(i => [i.key, i.fields?.status?.name, i.fields?.assignee?.displayName ?? '-', i.fields?.summary].join(' | ')).join('\n') + (t ? '\n[more: --set nextPageToken=' + t + ']' : '');
